text: Roughly 4 out of 5 ballots in California’s 2024 general election were cast by mail.

room.label: students (demo crowd)
room.note: No published poll has measured this belief yet. The 5C pilot survey replaces this split with real student answers.

truthSource.label: California Secretary of State: Historical Vote-by-Mail Ballot Use
truthSource.oneLine: In the November 2024 general election, 13,034,378 of 16,140,044 ballots cast (80.76%) were vote-by-mail ballots.

lesson.tip: Lines at polling places make in-person voting look like the norm, but most Californians vote by mail. Your own experience is a sample of one. For how people voted, check the Secretary of State’s vote-by-mail table.
